# Paper Slop Screen

Screen an ML research paper, as reviewer, area chair or co-author, for evidence of an absent author — unsteered research, unchecked artifacts and unpolished AI-led writing — and produce an evidence-cited grade on three axes (writing W0–W3, research steering R0–R3, ordinary quality Q) plus integrity flags and an auditability rating, never an AI probability.
